notes.title: We Have an English Version! Desert Blossom is now available in English!
notes.content:
- A Japanese role-playing game with a lot of yuri - Single plot mode, some characters' likability will affect the final Ending, there are 5 Endings - 200,000 words of plot text. Friendly, ATB combat that even AVG players can easily navigate - Character Illustration 25, CG 19

This marks our first attempt at releasing a language version outside of Chinese. Due to limited resources and fundingːsteamfacepalmː, there may still be some areas for improvement, but we have done our best to provide a high-quality experience.
We welcome your feedback! Feel free to contact us via email at 2262941959@qq.com or join our discussions in the Steam community. We also plan to create additional official channels to share updates about our progress.
We hope you enjoy our gameːsteamhappyː! If the feedback is positive, we will strive to launch future games with multiple language options from the start.

notes.title: 24/01/19 Optimized patch
notes.content: The adaptation of the controller is currently supported by NSpro, Xbox, PS, and domestic controller tests. The bug of incompatibility of the old gallery archive with a total of 34 images has been fixed, and the new CG1 will continue to be updated for free in mid-late February. Added initial map performance, optimized initial water reflection, maze mirror effects are still available. The next day, the limit challenge and the position of the two week mage are adjusted to the center of the road outside the main city castle, and the achievement division has been marked with a red arrow in the lower left corner of the main city. Galleries CG32, 33 for Chapter 5 Mother Agnes Isno's church Mother comes back after investigating the blue bed unlocks. Gallery CG34 adds voice theatre unlock to the right of the next day's Talk Dinner 2F Agiris. Props map no need to brush monster drop, by map pick + shop purchase can be collected. Optimized the feedback of high strength of yellow ribbon fish and adapted its own skills.

notes.content: The store page has increased the adaptation of the controller, the skill description interface has been optimized, and the magic/physical/recovery skill type icon has been added, the power range SABCD overview, Level dependency, etc. Agres added new abilities to the Castle after the episode of Ice/Fire Wrench, depending on Agres' > or < Yuan Pu's favorability, affecting different skill acquisition. notes.title: Desert Blossom v1.1 major update
notes.content:
Desert Blossom Major update, no additional charge to purchase DLC directly in the game for free! Like our works can join ZH RPG group QQ discussion group 1030084534, from time to time there are news, group friend welfare updates, and follow-up wonderful works preview. What's New:
① Added two small theaters, two new CG photos and three head pictures.
In Chapter 5, after defeating the third apostle, the Lord of Hell returns to the Village of the Valley - the church where Argress's mother is located to investigate the flash triggered, including a new CG and new content.
(2) The new small theater 2 needs to clear TE to enter the day after the talk, investigate the flash on the right side of Agnes to enter, including 1 new CG&3 new head pictures, and try to implant 13 voices, you can listen to the dialogue between Agnes and Mars.
Added Steam achievements system, 20 normal achievements +2 hidden achievements.
(3) Greatly improved the difficulty of acquiring money and experience, and increased the damage of Agri's Mercerization magic (the formula has become a Level dependent skill) and Mars Rock Magic (has become a Mars physical attack and enemy physical defense calculating damage). In-game gold goods have been broken (mostly at a discount of the original set price) to facilitate the collection of props.
④ After unlocking TE, in the main city Earl residence 2F, you can talk with the Bizhou mage to carry out the challenge of Bizhou level and item inheritance.
⑤ After unlocking TE, you can challenge 4 Apostles + 5 bosses of Cain in one breath.
⑥ New store page, increased the desert flower game features related key text description.
Useful group of three, before submission for the trilogy can focus group leader Bilibili account or add the group of free access to [url=https://space.bilibili.com/2770142] Bilibili Plones[/ url]
